text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Yaeno Muteki delivered a satisfying 
performance! Driven by "obsession," her 
fighting spirit flared up, and she felt 
she had achieved perfect "Union of Fire 
and Water."

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
However, it wasn't enough to overturn the 
audience's perception. Although some 
praised Yaeno Muteki's run, the majority 
said it would have been different if Oguri 
Cap had raced.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Yaeno Muteki strongly felt that she still 
had to defeat Oguri Cap. And now, she had 
the confidence to win.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Yaeno Muteki and the Trainer set their 
next goal on the Yasuda Kinen. All to take 
on Oguri Cap in a direct showdown!
